landing.badge: Smart appointment management for modern businesses
landing.heroDescription: AI-powered booking assistant, WhatsApp confirmations that eliminate no-shows, client tracking, and a mobile app to manage everything on the go.

problem.title: Stop wasting time on phone calls and no-shows
problem.description: Endless phone calls to explain services, clients who don't show up, and scattered notes across different apps. Slootea brings everything together and automates the busy work.

features.title: Everything you need to run smoothly
features.subtitle: Powerful features designed to help service-based businesses maximize their efficiency and revenue.

aiAssistant.title: AI Service Assistant
aiAssistant.description: Let AI handle customer inquiries 24/7. Clients can ask questions about services, pricing, and availability - getting instant answers without you having to pick up the phone.
aiAssistant.feature2: Answers client questions about services instantly
aiAssistant.feature3: Reduces time spent on phone calls by 70%

whatsappConfirmation.title: WhatsApp Confirmation System
whatsappConfirmation.description: Clients must confirm via WhatsApp that they're coming - or their slot gets automatically released to someone else. No more empty chairs.

clientTracking.title: Client Tracking & Notes
clientTracking.description: Build lasting relationships with detailed client profiles. Track visit history, preferences, and add notes that help you deliver personalized service every time.

mobileApp.title: Mobile App
mobileApp.description: Manage your business on the go. View appointments, get notifications, and stay connected with clients from anywhere using our native mobile app.

moreFeatures.title: And so much more
moreFeatures.subtitle: Every feature you need to manage appointments professionally

bookingLinks.title: Smart Booking Links
bookingLinks.description: Create custom shareable links for specific services or campaigns.

scheduling.title: Intelligent Scheduling
scheduling.description: Set working hours, buffer time, and let the system handle availability.

teamManagement.title: Team Management
teamManagement.description: Manage multiple providers, assign services, and track individual performance.

analytics.title: Reports & Analytics
analytics.description: Track no-show rates, busiest hours, and team performance in one dashboard.

dataIntegration.title: Data Integration Support
dataIntegration.description: We help you migrate your existing client data and integrate with your current systems seamlessly.

howItWorks.title: Get started in three simple steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No complex setup required. Start accepting bookings within minutes.

step1.title: Create your services
step1.description: Add the services you offer with durations and descriptions. Assign team members if you have a team.

step2.title: Set your availability
step2.description: Define your working hours and any blocked times. Use templates or customize completely.

step3.title: Share and grow
step3.description: Share your booking link with clients. They book, you focus on delivering great service.

testimonials.title: Loved by professionals everywhere
testimonials.subtitle: See what our customers have to say about transforming their booking experience.

testimonial1.quote: Slootea reduced our no-show rate by 35% in the first month. The automatic confirmations are a game changer.
